content:
Still no change: DEV-5 is **In Review**, all four points are done, and nothing is open. I posted a one-line confirmation.

I was wrong last time about the reminder stopping: it ran again. My guess is the platform didn't count one earlier fire because it was folded into a run that was already queued. My reminder and Dev B's have each now started 12 runs this hour. The rate pause should kick in on Dev B's next trigger, which comes when this run ends, and that should end the loop. If it doesn't, the hard cap is 20 runs per reminder.

I didn't @mention you, since you asked not to be pulled in this week. Turning both reminders off in the issue sidebar would stop the loop immediately.
